Final real run: docs/methods/robustness_extra.md uses MSCI history from 2000-12-29 and N=5503 versus paper 6097. It uses one extra signal lag with the current week4 dummy and a compounded two-day stock control. These limits do not identify the large Threshold-gap cause; it is unknown.

Final real run: docs/methods/pension.md uses asset-weighted allocations and changing observed contributor sets in 2003-2022. There are 253 source rows per year but 172-228 actual and 136-234 target contributors. Actual min/max and typical target differ substantially from the paper. The exact cause is unknown; coverage and source vintage are candidates, not established causes.

Final real run: docs/methods/trading_corr.md uses 867 COT pairs, 125 LTPos pairs and 194 ICI pairs per signal. ICI pools within recovered blocks without bridging missing intervals; ANcerno is unavailable. All ten available correlation signs agree. Source coverage and lag conventions limit magnitude comparisons; the residual-gap cause is unknown.
